errors.retryCondition: Never reuse the same mutation ID for a different intent.
errors.description: The supplied AdminMutationId was already committed for a different canonical Key mutation intent.

errors.retryCondition: Only with an owner-visible live ArtifactRef and a valid offset.
errors.description: The Artifact is unknown, expired, released, outside its body range, or owned by another Key; the response does not disclose which.

errors.retryCondition: Correct the reported input/state; do not silently repeat a possibly delivered effect.
errors.description: The upload transition fails chunk, offset, length, completeness or integrity checks.

errors.retryCondition: Only after the reported capability fact changes.
errors.description: The required Chromium API, host grant or user-controlled platform toggle is unavailable before command effect dispatch.

errors.retryCondition: Only after the wall clock returns to the derived safe representable domain.
errors.description: The extension cannot safely advance or compare its monotonic security time. This code is emitted only before a browser, page, network, or debug effect; an operation accepted earlier may be durably settled KnownNoEffect before its dispatch fence.

errors.retryCondition: Only with a declared method and schemaVersion.
errors.description: The exact method and schemaVersion pair is not declared in this build.

errors.retryCondition: Only after the reported foreign occupation is released.
errors.description: Another Key owns a global or exact-tab occupation that blocks this acquire or page-effect dispatch.

errors.retryCondition: Inspect commandMayHaveRun; never automatically replay a CDP command after dispatch or result failure.
errors.description: Explicit debugging operation failed; details preserve whether a command may already have run.

errors.retryCondition: Correct the reported input/state; do not silently repeat a possibly delivered effect.
errors.description: The input is not HTML or the explicitly selected tab is not an eligible demo tab.

errors.retryCondition: Only after correcting the selector, node kind, value, or page state.
errors.description: A fixed DOM query or action could not be applied to the current target element.

errors.retryCondition: Correct the reported shape, visible region, stable geometry or registered budget.
errors.description: Element geometry is empty, changed, unsupported or above its capture budget; no screenshot fallback occurs.

errors.retryCondition: Only after the authenticated Key permission facts change.
errors.description: The authenticated Key does not satisfy the command permission expression.

errors.retryCondition: Never infer retry safety from this code; inspect phase evidence.
errors.description: A bounded internal failure occurred in a currently active no-effect command.

errors.retryCondition: Only after this authenticated Key is explicitly enabled.
errors.description: The correctly authenticated Key is currently disabled.

errors.retryCondition: Only after an authorized expiry mutation or use of another valid Key.
errors.description: The correctly authenticated Key has reached its half-open expiry boundary.

errors.retryCondition: Only with an existing KeyId.
errors.description: An authorized Key management command targeted a KeyId that does not exist.

errors.retryCondition: Never update a revoked Key; create a new Key if needed.
errors.description: The target Key is irrevocably revoked and cannot accept the requested mutation.

errors.retryCondition: Only after the same extension instance reports authority hydration ready.
errors.description: The extension authority and operation storage have not completed safe hydration.

errors.retryCondition: After releasing/expiring stored results, reducing the request, or changing a registered limit.
errors.description: A registered count, byte, reference, or Artifact capacity limit would be exceeded.

errors.retryCondition: Correct the reported state; never silently replay when clickState is unknown.
errors.description: The native click could not be safely addressed or fully confirmed; details state the phase and whether input is known absent.

errors.retryCondition: Only after a currently authorized Key explicitly queries an owner-visible result.
errors.description: Final disclosure authorization changed after work began, so result content is withheld while phase evidence remains truthful.

errors.retryCondition: Reload the current Key record and retry an admin mutation with its new revision.
errors.description: A Key admin mutation supplied a stale expected record revision. Tabs paging no longer uses this error.

errors.retryCondition: After correcting the request schema.
errors.description: An incoming transport-to-command envelope or command parameter failed its closed schema before admission and before any command effect. Generated plans, adapter results, receipts, and response values must use a phase-sensitive typed error instead.

errors.retryCondition: Only after the trusted local admin attaches the original token to a legacy Key record.
errors.description: The target legacy Key has verifier material but no stored API Key token that can be revealed.

errors.retryCondition: Only after the reported storage, quota, schema, or integrity condition changes.
errors.description: Required authority storage cannot currently provide the declared safety contract; the response carries phase-specific effect evidence.

errors.retryCondition: Call tabs.list again and use a newly returned TabRef.
errors.description: The syntactically valid TabRef belongs to an unprovable runtime or no longer resolves to its original live Chromium tab.

errors.retryCondition: Call frames.list and dom.query again to obtain current references.
errors.description: The DocumentRef or NodeRef no longer resolves to its original live document or isolated-world node token.

errors.retryCondition: Only with a valid active Key credential.
errors.description: The supplied credential is malformed, unknown, revoked, unsupported, or has the wrong secret.
